title: G17 · 拒绝
body: Generation 17 preserves the six proven champion kernels and targets its two relatively slow tasks. Word-frequency selection now uses count buckets and a bounded lexical heap, eliminating per-vocabulary pair allocations and unnecessary tie-bucket sorting without changing tokenization or ordering. Prime generation now uses a carefully derived segmented six-wheel, reducing candidate scanning by about one third and composite marking by more than half while retaining the same ascending prime output. The independent operation-count reductions should produce a product above the 1.477 acceptance threshold and a geometric aggregate above 62.7×.
